name: Mississippi
notes: bbox is [min_lon, min_lat, max_lon, max_lat], matching pmtiles extract --bbox. Mississippi's extent (Census TIGER, rounded outward). The south edge is the Gulf barrier islands (Ship, Horn, Petit Bois); open Gulf beyond them is trimmed, Mississippi Sound inside the box cannot be. maxzoom 14 is where OSM street geometry stops adding detail; z15+ roughly doubles the file for labels the phone can render from z14 data.

geofabrik.notes: Not used for the roads basemap (Protomaps already renders the planet). It is the input the routing graph needs, and the state.txt timestamp is what check_upstream.py watches for maps-routing-us-ms.
